I own ME1 & ME2 here on Steam. You can see my posted reviews (it's public) and I recommend ME1 & ME2. I gave both those games 10/10. 

Sadly, ME3 is...terrible game and the fact that it required to have ORIGIN (EA) to play the game an insult to Bioware fans and those who played ME1 & ME2...how many times do I have to tell gamers to stay away and not support EA. 

So then, why did I buy this game?

Let me answer that question:
It was on sale and I have 100% Achievement (through origins) that were transferred to my Steam. I have 100% ME1 & ME2. I know my ME Trilogy well (as also the lore). 

Therefore, since I 100% ME3 it was something I wanted to showcase since I've written Guides, Reviews, Walkhtrough all available. 

Save your money. Don't buy the game. Don't support EA.

An RPG with an amazing story, Complex characters, Unique alien space universe, lore and good 3rd person combat. Great team based MP.

Up until an hour ago, i'd never finished ME3. I'd played it, sure, back on 360 when it first came out but i never finished it. 

Well, i'm 26 years old and i'm crying at that ending. It's so perfect. So peaceful. Exactly how a space adventure should end. Obviously there are some gripes i have about particular things and i totally understand why certain people feel a certain way about it. But personally, that gameplay and ending made for one of the best nights of my life and i feel bad on myself for not allowing myself to finish this years ago when it came out.

10/10. Please play this game. I know people hate it for their own reasons but do yourself a favor and just play through it once. It'll make you feel things you never thought possible at your age. It did for me.

As much as I love this game, this steam release is not the best.

Honestly I don't like to condone piracy, but Origin is so invasive that I would rather play a cracked version than deal with it at times.

Not to mention that the PC port of ME3 in general kinda sucks, some of the immediate problems include;


- Having to edit ini files to disable V-sync (Not that you'd really want to, as frame-rates above 60fps make it so enemies are more accurate and shields regen slower making game-play impossible at times)

- No native controller support (Just like the first two games) you can download a single-player controller mod here : https://www.nexusmods.com/masseffect3/mods/407

- Having to download 3rd party mods to enable different FOV settings

- Origin overlay kills performance so you have to disable it

- The UI scaling is broken (Higher resolutions make it small and hard to read)

Mods do fix most of these issues, but having to do all this unnecessary setup is annoying.
It's a shame because I enjoy this game and franchise, and it sucks that EA did a lackluster job porting this game to PC.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Update 2025

Quite literally no reason to buy this version anymore. Unless you have a burning desire to play the multiplayer. The Legendary Edition is the way to go full stop. Fixes all of the issues above with the added bonus of up to date mod support PLUS the first two games.
